name: Quadrille
summary: Four-player Ombre-family trick game where declarer calls a King for a hidden partner or plays solo to win six of ten tricks.
rules_text: Four players get ten cards from a 40-card pack (8-9-10 removed). Two black Aces are permanent top trumps: Spadille (Ace spades) highest, then Manille (7 red or 2 black of trump suit), then Baste (Ace clubs). Bidding determines the Taker who names trump. Lowest contract is a call: Taker names a King and its holder becomes concealed partner. Higher contracts are Médiateur and sans-prendre, played solo vs three. Play is trick-taking, must follow suit if possible, trumping optional. Three true Matadors may refuse to follow a lower trump lead. First side to six tricks wins; five is remise, four or less codille, ten is vole. Counters (jetons/fish) settle stakes and Matadors.
rating_reason: Bid, concealed partnership via called King, solo vs three.
